asset_family: Fablewood Illuminated Grove / Ink Goblin / walk

anchor.semantic: bottom-center ground contact; populated in every delivered frame at local y=224

phase_authority: Parent adapter must retain existing progress-linked phase; do not drive from independent wall-clock time.

direction_orientation.SE: generated canonical front three-quarter elevated-isometric walk; chest bark-paper planes and both restrained violet eyes visible
direction_orientation.SW: safe horizontal mirror of SE; design has no weapon, logo, readable text, or meaningful asymmetric accessory
direction_orientation.NE: generated canonical elevated-isometric rear three-quarter walk facing up-right/away; back of head and layered folded bark-paper back mantle are visible, with no face, eyes, chest armor, front torso, or breastplate
direction_orientation.NW: safe horizontal mirror of NE; design has no weapon, logo, readable text, or meaningful asymmetric accessory

consumer_inspection.enemy_animation_gd: CELL=(256,256), ANCHOR=(128,224), COLUMNS=8, FRAME_COUNT=48, FPS=24, DURATION=2.0; its legacy SHEETS table presently expects one non-directional goblin sheet.
consumer_inspection.world_gd: Legacy standard-enemy facing mirrors only when segment direction.x-direction.y < 0; enemy_sprite_transform mirrors about the contact point exactly once. No source changes were made. A parent directional adapter must choose these four directional sheets before applying no additional directional mirror.

processing.chroma_background: #FF00FF selected by video_to_sprites.py choose-bg (higher contrast score 230.992 vs 215.008 neon green)
processing.carrier_extraction: SE: 48 frames uniformly sampled from the 4.000-second, 1280x720, 24fps generated carrier. NE: 48 frames uniformly sampled from the successful 4.041667-second, 1280x720, 24fps Seedance 2.5 carrier. Both use 24fps/2.0-second in-game playback.

chroma_key.result: final sampled frame 0000 measured zero opaque strong-magenta pixels under the recorded spill predicate

processing.normalization: normalize_goblin_sheets.py resizes processed 280x450 union frames at 0.43, alpha-composites them in fixed 256x256 cells, and aligns every visible alpha bottom to row 224; sheets are lossless RGBA WebP
